title: Habit Body Text 2
description: Thomas Hauert and Zoo Company have developed an exercise they call the Careful Scientist, which uses a very tight set of rules to complicate the coordination between limbs across the two sides of the body. The ultimate goal of this exercise is to translate the intricate combinations it produces to any joint of the body, including the fingers, toes, and the chain of the spine.
